Built a rocket game for kids with my AI team today. Kerbal Space Program was my favorite as a kid and there is no simple version for phones, so we made one.

Build your rocket, launch, touch the clouds, reach space, and go all the way around the planet. Real physics underneath, simple buttons on top.

First try at orbit and I made it 😆
